card.name: Word stems before -aneous endings
card.fires_on: The first part of words that finish as -aneous or -aneously, such as contempor-, simult-, spont-, miscell-. It fires at the break just before the "-an-" ending.

modes.label: contempor- stem
modes.description: The stem of contemporaneous, contemporary or contemporaries, at the break before the ending.

modes.label: Other -aneous words
modes.description: Stems of spontaneous, simultaneously and miscellaneous, split before the ending.

card.plain: It marks the start of long words like contemporaneous or spontaneous, where the ending -aneous comes next.
